items.text: LA Rams (early week): WR Puka Nacua (MCL/PCL sprains + turf toe) likely headed to IR per McVay. IR - WR Davante Adams (hamstring surgery), TE Terrance Ferguson, CB Jaylen Watson, DE Kobie Turner, DT Poona Ford, K Blake Grupe (season). Questionable - LG Steve Avila (hamstring). Matthew Stafford starts.
items.source: NBC Sports/Rotoworld (McVay: Nacua likely headed to IR, Nov 9)

items.text: Arizona (early week): QB Gardner Minshew OUT (feared torn UCL, throwing elbow; likely season-ending surgery); Jacoby Brissett traded to BAL; rookie Carson Beck in line to start (no prior start, so the model can't take a qb_start override; it still prices Minshew). OUT - WR Michael Wilson (neck, season), WR Jalen Brooks (wrist). IR - RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle). Monitor - C Hjalte Froholdt (concussion), DT Roy Lopez (toe).
items.source: NFL.com (Minshew likely needs season-ending surgery; Beck in line to start, Nov 9)
